name: Rectifier and signal diodes
summary: General diodes that let current flow one way: power rectifiers and small signal diodes.
uses: Blocking reverse current from a solar panel or battery
identify: Black cylinders with a grey or white band (1N4007, 1N5408) or tiny glass ones with a black band (1N4148), on every power supply, charger and appliance board.
test: On diode mode: about 0.5–0.7V forward and open in reverse. Zero both ways means shorted; open both ways means dead.
